scope: Exactly MELI, UBER, NOW; no price ranking or growth forecast.
common_method: All normalized EPS values are analyst adjustments to GAAP, hence are not reported GAAP measures. Explicit normalized tax assumptions prevent indefinite capitalization of discrete tax items.

TTM monetary flows = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025. Historical diluted-share proxy = FY2025 average + (H1 2026 average - H1 2025 average) * 181/365. This reconstructs a period-weighted proxy; it is not a separately reported TTM dilution calculation.

Reported income tables round to millions, so reported-EPS sums can differ from reconstructed income/share EPS. Recommended values round to cents and are conditional model anchors, not precision claims.

EPS multiple valuation includes debt interest; do not subtract debt from the resulting equity value a second time. Any added excess investments/cash require a matching treatment of associated earnings and restrictions.
Access/retrieval date for all sources: 2026-09-12. Exact filing accessions and date filters were checked for primary XBRL extracts.

companies.basis: TTM through 2026-06-30; GAAP pretax income retained, including all compensation, D&A, financing, credit provisioning and FX; replace reported taxes with an assumed 30% normalized tax rate.
limits: 30% is an analyst assumption close to FY2025 reported effective tax of 29.73%; H1 2026 fell to 25.5%, partly from Brazilian deferred-tax gains. No discrete benefit amount was sufficiently isolated to claim an exact removal.
GAAP compensation is retained. The long-term retention programme is cash payable; its expense is not an SBC addback merely because equity dilution is small.

The $956m cash remainder is not owner FCF: customer/card funding flows, restricted balances, credit capital, securitization and lease commitments remain. Do not value customer restricted cash as excess corporate cash.
No shipping, credit-card launch, lending provision or FX cost is added back. The input is a historical earnings proxy, not a forecast of credit-normalized earnings.

companies.basis: Strict GAAP-derived TTM earnings: retain SBC, D&A, acquired amortization and all operating legal/restructuring/acquisition costs; zero noninterest other income; use 24% normalized tax; retain equity-method losses and minority/diluted-numerator effects.

issuer_adjusted_metric_check.reason: Neither Non-GAAP Operating Income nor Non-GAAP Net Income reconciliation adds SBC back. Adjusted EBITDA does exclude SBC and is a different metric.
issuer_adjusted_metric_check.note: Summing disclosed H1/annual EPS gives 2.89 because denominators and rounding differ; use the numerator/share bridge (~2.883), not the earlier rough sum.

limits: 24% is an explicit analyst normalized tax assumption, consistent with H1 2026 issuer adjusted tax; cash taxes are presently lower and should not be capitalized permanently.
The stricter EPS retains costs the issuer excludes and retains equity-method/NCI charges. It does not capitalize transient tax releases or investment marks.

FCF includes SBC addbacks and insurance-reserve growth and excludes acquisitions/strategic investments. Restricted insurance assets are not excess cash. Strategic equity/AV investments require separate risk and capital treatment.
If using the issuer ~$2.883 alternative, disclose its remaining exclusions. Do not subtract SBC twice: it is already expensed in both EPS measures.

companies.basis: Strict GAAP-derived TTM: retain SBC, acquired amortization, severance and acquisition expenses; retain interest income/expense; zero noninterest other income including strategic-investment marks; assume 25% normalized tax.
limits: The December 17, 2025 5-for-1 split is already reflected in both filings and all stated EPS/shares. Do not divide these EPS values by five again.
25% is a tax-normalization assumption, not an issuer forecast. FY2025 reported effective tax was 22.7%; H1 2026 was 31%, with SBC shortfalls and a California valuation-allowance release.

This is a historical acquisition-perimeter proxy, not a fully pro-forma annual run rate. Newly acquired revenue/cost, amortization and financing need a forward bridge: Q2 interest expense alone was $66m versus $83m across the reconstructed TTM.

Issuer adjusted operating profit excludes SBC; its FCF also adds back acquisition-related cash costs. Plain FCF remains before equity compensation economics and acquisition spending. Do not label adjusted margins owner margins.
TTM cash-flow SBC ($2185m) differs from income-statement expense ($2199m); the EPS calculation starts from GAAP operating income and retains the full expense.
